record.title: Correlate stock kernel modules and public XDMA reference with userspace ABI
record.intent: Recover the software device contract while keeping FPGA behavior explicitly unresolved.
requirements: Locate and hash relevant exact stock kernel modules and report absent or unproven module associations.
Recover device naming, file operations, mmap extent/protection/lifetime, ioctl layouts and error paths where the binaries or pinned reference support them.
Correlate DMA, C2H/H2C, buffer/alignment and asynchronous interfaces with the stock userspace inventory.
Separate exact-module evidence from public reverse-engineered source behavior and any unresolved correspondence.
Do not infer FPGA reset values, register effects, timing, completion, interrupts or sample data from software plumbing.
Read-only analysis only; no module loading, guest run, physical access or artifact modification.
acceptance: Typed ABI evidence and uncertainty records identify which plumbing is recoverable and which boundaries still require runtime selection or behavioral evidence.
No equivalence claim between Orange-Rigol and actual MHO984 behavior without corroboration.
